remarks: Completely updated 3-4 Bedroom 3.5 Bath home set on private lot on cul-de-sac. New Granite kitchen with all the amenities, including wine cooler, 6 seat island which opens to Family Room with french doors to the deck overlooking nicely landscaped backyard with shed. Living Room with Gas fireplace and Dining room. Full walkout In-law with separate entrance that opens to patio, plus playroom. Private fenced in backyard. Don't miss this - won't last! Very convenient location near shopping, I-95, restaurants, etc.
